sources.title: BIM and AI: how to obtain a 3D model with artificial intelligence
sources.snippet: Among the methodologies most closely linked to automation and technological innovation, BIM stands out, a tool that has revolutionized the way of designing. Artificial intelligence can further enhance this methodology, making complex processes simpler and faster, such as the automatic conversion of 2D drawings or images into 3D BIM models.

sources.title: BIMxAI - Transform 2D Floor Plans into 3D BIM Models
sources.snippet: BIMxAI is an AI-powered platform that converts 2D architectural floor plans into detailed, IFC-ready 3D BIM models in minutes - with up to 90%+ detection accuracy.

sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Modly generates 3D meshes from your photos or a text prompt using open-source AI models. All locally, unlimited and completely free.
